summary: Update site styling so section tiles use the 'Your Ideal Destinations' background color and borders match the existing tile border color used elsewhere on the website.
architectural_notes: Use existing design tokens/colors already present on the site: tile background should match the 'Your Ideal Destinations' section background; tile borders should match the current border styling used by other tiles elsewhere on the website.

existing_features.title: Update the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results page so the three result sections (“Your Travel Style”, “Your Ideal Destinations”, and “Your Personal Packing List”) render as distinct tiles with a filled background using the same background color currently used by the “Your Ideal Destinations” section, and do not render a full-width colored stripe behind the tiles.

Make the borders for the three finishing/results section tiles use the same border color and general border treatment as other tiles used elsewhere on the site (consistent thickness, radius, and overall look).

Adjust the quiz page-level background styling so the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results screen does not appear as a single full-page colored block; ensure only the tiles carry the “Your Ideal Destinations” background color.

new_feature_requests.summary: Adjust section tiles styling: use 'Your Ideal Destinations' background color for all tiles; remove full-width stripe backgrounds; set borders to match existing tile border styling across the site.
